text_block_list.text:
""【Chanko Hotpot Contest Announcement!】 
Let's all make and share our proudest 
chanko hotpots☆ Sign up right here~""

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —And... posted!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I hope everyone has fun this time too~

One day, I took part in a "Chankonabe 
Meetup," a fan event hosted by Hishi 
Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I'm amazed so many people showed up. 
Thanks for coming today, everyone~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
As I wrote on Umastagram, today everyone 
will be making their own chanko nabe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Did you make sure to bring your recipe~?

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fans
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, looking perfect~☆ Let's all have 
fun together~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And so, let's get cooking!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's interesting how even the way you 
make the broth is different~.

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we make our broth slowly using our 
seafood selection of kelp, bonito flakes, 
and dried sardines~.

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I prioritize saving time, so for the 
dashi, I use a blend of store-bought dashi 
and chicken stock—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, both of them smell super buono~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, your hot pot has gochujang and 
kimchi—it's a spicy chanko nabe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yours is miso chanko! Nice, smells so 
sweet and rich~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting so fired up! Let's make the 
best chankonabe ever~!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um... I saw you in the last stream! You're 
Bono-chan's Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Actually, getting to see that side of 
Buono-chan as an Umamusume in that stream 
made me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And after that, I somehow got interested 
in racing too. I'm definitely going to go 
watch Bono-chan's next race!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, actually, me too...! Racing really 
is so exciting, isn't it~?"

It seemed Hishi Akebono's plan to stuff 
the audience full of food was working!

In such a friendly, harmonious atmosphere, 
the chanko nabe party went on. But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...? Ah, this scent—

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, wait a second. Pork plus curry 
roux... Isn't that just plain old curry at 
that point?"

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"Still, our kids love this chanko the 
most. They always say this one tastes the 
best—"

At the edge of the venue, a small argument 
broke out.

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason, especially if we're 
feeding children. We must pass down proper 
chanko nabe to them.

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
My grandfather, who was a chef, used to 
say it too. The basics are chicken 
meatballs and vegetables, right?

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan D
text_block_list.text: B-But—

As the tension in the air sharply spiked— 
Hishi Akebono's relaxed voice rang out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
True, chanko nabe packed with meatballs 
and veggies is super buono, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan C
text_block_list.text: ! Buono-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, chanko nabe recipes vary wildly 
depending on the sumo stable, you know~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It can be salty or spicy. Some sumo 
wrestlers even put cheese or yogurt in 
theirs."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Each stable comes up with its own twists, 
and that's how their unique chanko nabe is 
born."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Because they're different, they become the 
taste of precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"That's why, you know, I think it'll be 
just fine even without the meatballs or 
veggies~"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If eating it energizes someone and makes 
them go "Let's do our best again!", then 
that's what makes it true chankonabe!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I think my vision might 
have gotten a little too narrow."

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm the one who should apologize... I 
was being strangely stubborn."

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm so sorry, Buono-chan. Even 
though you put so much effort into this 
event.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. No, no! There's no need to worry 
about it~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, the broth of your 
chankonabe looks so clear and delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This chanko nabe was made with so much 
care for the traditional basics, wasn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yours is curry flavor, and the meat chunks 
are huge! It looks soooo yummy♪ I bet tons 
of people will love it~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else's chanko nabe varies too, 
some are spicy, some are creamy—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They were all different, but they all look 
so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to eating it 
with everyone later~♪

As if drawn in by Hishi Akebono's 
heartwarming presence, the chanko nabe 
party drew to a close in a warm, cozy 
atmosphere—
The bond with the fans grew even deeper!
A few days later.

""【Chanko Hotpot Party with All Our 
Fans!】 Thanks for coming to the chanko 
contest~!""

"Everyone's chanko nabe was absolutely 
buono~!"

"I'll protect my flavor, and everyone will 
protect theirs, okay~☆"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —And... posted!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that was fun. I'm so satisfied 
getting to eat tons of chanko nabe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Besides... so many more people have 
started taking an interest in racing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...All right! Let's do this~!

Once summer training camp is over, it's 
time for the Sprinters Stakes. In order to 
give our all in the race, our days of 
further rigorous training begin!
